connector.name: SPM - Structured Project Memory
connector.registryDescription: Durable, shareable and governed project memory with smart triage and explicit project composition.
connector.summary: Hosted at getspm.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.getspm, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token authorized for one project, a selected project set or the projects available to an organization user.
